info.title: Grants.gov Search API: federal grants list with deadlines
info.description:
Which federal grants are open right now? Searches Grants.gov and returns opportunity, agency, deadline, eligibility and the source link.

More: https://apify.com/publicrecords/grants-gov-scraper

Input.title: Grants.gov Opportunities Scraper
Input.description: Public Grants.gov search2 API. No API key. Response token/accessKey are ignored. Server date filter: postedWithinDays → dateRange. open/close date fields are client-side (API does not support custom MM/DD ranges).

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Search keyword (e.g. education, cybersecurity). Leave empty for all.

agency.title: Agency
agency.description: Mapped to API body agencies (e.g. HHS, EPA, NSF).

status.title: Opportunity status
status.description: Mapped to API oppStatuses. Use forecasted|posted|closed|archived or pipe-joined.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within N days
postedWithinDays.description: Server-side filter mapped to search2 dateRange (posted-date lookback). Verified values: 3,7,14,21,28,35,42,49,56,90,180,365. Omit for no posted-date filter.

openDateFrom.title: Open date from
openDateFrom.description: Client-side filter on openDate. Accepts MM/DD/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD. Inclusive.

closeDateFrom.title: Close date from
closeDateFrom.description: Client-side filter on closeDate. Inclusive. Useful for 'still open' windows.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Cap on opportunity rows (deduped by opportunityId).

fetchDetails.title: Fetch opportunity details
fetchDetails.description: Hydrate synopsis via fetchOpportunity. Still one PPE charge per opportunity.

post.summary: Run Grants.gov Search API: federal grants list with deadlines
post.description: Runs the job and returns the result rows as JSON (waits up to 280 s).
